comment.narrative: 05-03-2022: 9 course modules- (curricula); 4 1 year after the end of the project, and 5 2 years after the end of the project 9 modules validated by the Rector of the UAC

10-08-2023: Eight sexual health and reproductive rights (SRHR) modules were planned to be developed for integration into the training offers of the National Universities of Benin (UNB). The project went beyond the target and developed nine modules. On September 27 to 28, 2021, the Center for University Pedagogy and Quality Assurance (CPUAQ) of the University of Abomey-Calavi conducted the validation of these modules.

10-08-2023: The curriculum comprises nine sexual health and reproductive rights (SRHR) modules developed for integration into the training offers of the National Universities of Benin (UNB). The project went beyond the milestone of 8 modules and developed nine modules as follows: • Introduction to SRHR • International and National Contexts of SRHR • Governance of SRHR • Health Services and SRHR • SRHR of Marginalised groups • SRHR and Eco-Justice • Sexual and Gender-Based Violence • Accountability for Safe Learning Environments • Communication in SRHR
These modules also comply with the standards of the West African Higher Education Network (REESAO) and the African and Malagasy Council for Higher Education (CAMES) in terms of training module development.

comment.narrative: 10-08-2023: 2 journal articles (drawing on research on sexual harassment and young student parents within universities) are under revision. 4 policy briefs on diverse issues (see below) developed and have been presented to policymakers at the advocacy dinner held during the DSSR-BJ project-funded International Conference on SRHR in December 2022. ● Policy brief 1: Sexual harassment in academia in Benin: Manifestations, motivations and recommendations ● Policy brief 2: Lived experiences of student parents in a university environment in Benin: Support system, coping mechanisms and recommendations ● Policy brief 3: SRHR challenges in universities in Benin: Mapping, analysis of needs and recommendations for effective actions ● Policy brief 4: Are Beninese universities sensitive to gender and social inclusion?

comment.narrative: 10-08-2023: By the end of the year, the DSSR-BJ project already trained a total of 120 academic and professional staff on Sexual Health and Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR). The first batch of training was the Master Trainers’ Certificate Course held in July and the second batch was the Online Training on SRHR for Public Universities, NGOs, and Ministry professionals conducted from October to November 2021.

24-08-2023: By the end of 2022, the DSSR-BJ project had trained a total of 160 academic and professional staff on Youth Centered Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR). The training of 20 Master Trainers in July 2021 was the first point of cascade. These Master Trainers in turn cascaded training to 100 academic staff in November 2021. In May and June 2022, twenty (20) graduate students and practitioners at UAC received online training on Gender and Sexuality. Finally, 20 academic staff from the four public universities received training in gender and social inclusion in August 2022.
